title: handleCreateIntakeSession uses old callFlow-style HTTP pattern instead of createDocumentRequest
detail: Lines 347-394: handleCreateIntakeSession reads `getEnvVar('dcfg_flow_intake_setup_url')` then directly `fetch(flowUrl, ...)`. This is the deprecated HTTP-trigger flow pattern. Per engineering journal Â§5 and CLAUDE.md, the DCFG architecture migrated to the Dataverse transaction table pattern: write to dcfg_document_requests, flow triggers on row creation. All other wizards (NewContractWizard, NewProposalWizard, CapitalPlan, ContractDetail) use createDocumentRequest(). interviewGenerate.js is cataloged in CR-2026-04-09-0006 as another stale caller. OnboardingDetail is a third stale caller.
evidence: OnboardingDetail.jsx:355-376 â€” getEnvVar + raw fetch against flowUrl. Compare to CapitalPlan.jsx:90-98 using createDocumentRequest.
recommendedFix: Replace the fetch block with `await createDocumentRequest({ requestType: DocRequestType.IntakeSetup, requestedBy: user?.email, name: 'Intake setup - ' + custName, customerId: custId, notes: JSON.stringify({ access_code: code, provider_name: custName, case_id: ... }) });` â€” may require adding IntakeSetup to the DocRequestType enum in portalApi.js. Update the flow trigger to read from dcfg_document_requests instead of HTTP. Coordinate with the intake-session flow owner.

title: handleStepFieldSave logs error to console only â€” no user toast
detail: Line 285-296: `handleStepFieldSave` wraps the PATCH in try/catch but only `console.error('Step field save failed:', err)`. Every other handler in this file uses toast.show('err', ...) â€” this one is the outlier. Admins editing a step field and hitting a save failure get no feedback.
recommendedFix: Add `toast?.show('err', 'Failed to save field: ' + err.message);` alongside the console.error.
